notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.notes:
QoL Update.

Quality of Life Update brings the following..
[list]
[*] Better gamepad support,
[*] New option to turn off flashing,
[*] Cloud saves,
[*] Fixes to CRT shader,
[*] Support for newer graphics libraries such as DX11,
[*] Various minor tweaks.
[/list]

notes.title: New Beta
notes.notes:
There is a new build for both Windows and Linux available under the Beta tab.
Changes include..
Windows: Added support for more Gamepads, general fixes and tweaks.
Linux: Compiled using YYC (up to 50% faster) to bring the Linux build inline with the Win build. Added support for more Gamepads, general fixes and tweaks.
